description: List the dedicated / bare-metal servers on the account: service_id, hostname, product, location and state. The service_id it returns is what every other `impreza_dedicated_*` tool takes. Note dedicated servers are provisioned by the Impreza team, not instantly like a VPS — a freshly ordered one only shows up here once it has been racked and handed over. Read-only.
name: impreza_list_dedicated
